actionConfiguration.body: SELECT imun003.imun003_id, imun001.imun001_desc AS vacina, imun003.imun003_datavalidade FROM "{{JSutils.currentSchema()}}".hotimun003 imun003 INNER JOIN "{{JSutils.currentSchema()}}".hotimun001 imun001 ON imun001.imun001_id = imun003.imun003_imun001 WHERE imun003.imun003_deleted <> true AND imun003.imun003_ani002_id = {{ appsmith.store.petID_Reserva }} AND imun003.imun003_datavalidade < CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY imun003.imun003_datavalidade ASC;
